role: Graduate civil or water engineer - expression of interest (Melbourne)
subject: Graduate civil or water engineer EOI, Melbourne, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am sending my CV for graduate or early career civil and water engineering work with Alluvium Consulting in Melbourne. Your careers page says you are always looking for people who want to make a positive impact, and your published graduate application notes invite a short cover letter and CV to info@alluvium.com.

I finish an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, covering road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked in the Philippines as a field engineer and project in charge on civil construction sites. I live in Melton, hold a White Card and an Australian drivers licence with my own transport, and have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027. I am available for site, office and regional work.

Your Melbourne urban water and waterways focus fits the stormwater documentation I have been building. I do not yet have Australian consulting experience, and I have not used HEC-RAS, TUFLOW or MUSIC on live jobs.

I have attached my resume and cover letter. I would welcome a short conversation about any graduate or early career place in the Melbourne team.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
